title: How to protect yourself in air pollution…

segments.text: India would save more years of Life by solving pollution than by curing cancer so when I recently traveled to India with Brian Johnson we followed a simple air protocol so here's what you can do in polluted environments one is use air filters in every room we actually carried around this portable air filter everywhere we went to make sure that we had clean air second monitor air quality with a portable device rely on the data so for example the gym at our hotel had terrible air quality so we worked out in our rooms instead in cars keep windows closed and use the circular air button

in hotels use AC systems to filter the air constantly and when Outdoors imputed air always wear an n95 mask if you're going to be exercising Outdoors make sure you check air quality before you do you can use apps like IQ a if you don't have a portable device each country has its own silent killer in India it's pollution in America it's obesity but the most important thing is that you know your environment and from there you can take control of your health
